name: epanel-plugin-mc-tools
description: 一些适用于 Minecraft 服务器的额外小工具。

scripts.build: node -e "(async function buildPluginPackage() { const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const esbuild = require('esbuild'); const root = process.cwd(); const packageFile = path.join(root, 'package.json'); const metadata = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(packageFile, 'utf8')); const write = (filename, value) => fs.writeFileSync(filename, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n'); const findSource = (directory, candidates) => candidates.map(candidate => path.join(directory, 'src', candidate)).find(filename => fs.existsSync(filename)); const compiledStyles = directory => { const files = []; const visit = current => { for (const item of fs.readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })) { const filename = path.join(current, item.name); if (item.isDirectory()) visit(filename); else if (item.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.css')) files.push(filename); } }; if (fs.existsSync(directory)) visit(directory); return files.sort().map(filename => path.relative(path.dirname(directory), filename).split(path.sep).join('/')); }; const relativizeBuiltAssets = directory => { const visit = current => { for (const item of fs.readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })) { const filename = path.join(current, item.name); if (item.isDirectory()) visit(filename); else if (item.name.endsWith('.js') || item.name.endsWith('.css')) { const text = fs.readFileSync(filename, 'utf8'); const quote = String.fromCharCode(34); const updated = text.split('new URL(' + quote + '/assets/').join('new URL(' + quote + './assets/').split('url(/assets/').join('url(./assets/').split(',self.location)').join(',import.meta.url)'); if (updated !== text) fs.writeFileSync(filename, updated); } } }; if (fs.existsSync(directory)) visit(directory); }; const sides = ['panel', 'daemon'].filter(side => metadata.elementspanel?.[side]); if (!sides.length) throw new Error('Plugin package has no panel or daemon side: ' + metadata.name); if (sides.length === 2 && metadata.elementspanel.dual === undefined) metadata.elementspanel.dual = true; for (const side of sides) { const definition = metadata.elementspanel[side]; const directory = path.join(root, definition.directory); const backend = findSource(directory, ['backend/index.ts', 'backend/index.js', 'index.ts', 'index.js']); const frontend = side === 'panel' ? findSource(directory, ['frontend.ts', 'frontend.tsx', 'frontend.jsx', 'frontend.js', 'index.ts', 'index.tsx', 'index.jsx', 'index.js']) : undefined; if (!backend) throw new Error('Missing backend source for ' + metadata.name + '/' + side); if (side === 'panel' && !frontend) throw new Error('Missing frontend source for ' + metadata.name + '/panel'); const pluginFile = path.join(directory, 'plugin.json'); const previous = fs.existsSync(pluginFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pluginFile, 'utf8')) : {}; for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(previous)) { if (['id', 'version', 'dual', 'backend', 'frontend', 'panel', 'daemon', 'main', 'entry', 'ui'].includes(key)) continue; const field = key === 'name' ? 'displayName' : key; if (definition[field] === undefined && metadata[field] === undefined && metadata.elementspanel[field] === undefined) definition[field] = value; } const manifest = { backend: 'backend/index.cjs' }; const output = path.join(directory, 'backend', 'index.cjs'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(output), { recursive: true }); await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [backend], outfile: output, bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'cjs', target: 'node22', packages: 'external', sourcemap: false, logLevel: 'warning' }); if (side === 'panel') { const { build } = await import('vite'); const vuePlugin = require('@vitejs/plugin-vue'); const vueJsxPlugin = require('@vitejs/plugin-vue-jsx'); const frontendOutput = path.join(directory, 'frontend'); const shared = ['vue', 'vue-router', 'pinia', 'vue-i18n', 'cordis', 'cosmokit', '@vueuse/core', '@vueuse/shared', '@elements-panel/sdk']; await build({ configFile: false, root: directory, plugins: [vuePlugin(), vueJsxPlugin()], build: { outDir: frontendOutput, emptyOutDir: true, sourcemap: false, rollupOptions: { input: frontend, preserveEntrySignatures: 'strict', external: id => shared.some(name => id === name || id.startsWith(name + '/')), output: { format: 'es', entryFileNames: 'index.js', chunkFileNames: '[name]-[hash].js', assetFileNames: 'assets/[name]-[hash][extname]' } } } }); manifest.frontend = 'frontend/index.js'; relativizeBuiltAssets(frontendOutput); const styles = compiledStyles(frontendOutput); if (styles.length) definition.styles = styles; else delete definition.styles; } write(pluginFile, manifest); } write(packageFile, metadata); console.log('Built ' + metadata.name + '@' + metadata.version); })().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });"
